queries.name: gold.client_unique.aggregation[0]
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN nom_reference IS NULL THEN 1 END) 
FROM client_unique

queries.name: gold.client_unique.cli_id.duplicate_count
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM client_unique
    WHERE cli_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cli_id)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1

queries.name: gold.client_unique.cli_id.duplicate_count.failing_sql
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT cli_id
    FROM client_unique
    WHERE cli_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cli_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT main.*
FROM client_unique main
JOIN frequencies ON main.cli_id = frequencies.cli_id

queries.name: gold.client_unique.cli_id.duplicate_count.passing_sql
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT cli_id
    FROM client_unique
    WHERE cli_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cli_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 1)
SELECT main.*
FROM client_unique main
JOIN frequencies ON main.cli_id = frequencies.cli_id

queries.name: gold.client_unique.cli_id.duplicate_count.failing_rows_sql_aggregated
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT cli_id, COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM client_unique
    WHERE cli_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cli_id)
SELECT *
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 100
